title: Expectation of a scaled function
statement: Let $A$ be a finite set, let $f:A\\to\\mathbb R$, and let $c\\in\\mathbb R$. The uniform average of $a\\mapsto f(a)/c$ equals the uniform average of $f$ divided by $c$.
